text:
tasha: Heads up 1: console telemetry shows a steady rise in fncall rejects for tool="profile_merge" on route="beta-union-test". Top reasons: "invalid_output_shape" and "missing_nullable_field". Anyone touched that model?

omar: Can you paste a minimized example from logs?

tasha: Sure, redacted sample: ```json
{"req_id":"r-ff1","tool":"profile_merge","error":"invalid_output_shape","expected":{"type":"object","fields":{"user":{"type":"union","options":["id",{"type":"object","fields":["id","metadata?"]}]}}},"actual":{"user":{"id":"u-12","metadata":null}}}```

greta: Looks like the schema expects metadata to be optional (nullable?) on the object branch, but our validator treats explicit null as a missing field in this config. We recently tightened union handling in the validator lib.

hugo: Did that tightened change roll to beta-union-test? It should've been gated.

tasha: Query: `select count(*) from invokes where tool=\'profile_merge\' and reject=true and route=\'beta-union-test\' and ts > now()-interval \'2 hours\'` -> ~420 rejects, mostly from a single customer shard. Support started paging.

omar: Immediate mitigations: 1) adapter can treat explicit null as valid for optional fields (coerce_null=true) and mark trace `validation_action=coerced_null`; 2) route traffic off beta-union-test until we patch validator; 3) revert validator tightening. Which do we prefer?

greta: Revert would be safest but slower if model teams depend on tighter checks. Short-term I favor adapter coercion + tag so we stop pages. Add TTL on shim (2 hours) so we don't mask drift forever.

hugo: Telemetry: we must add `validation_reason=missing_nullable_field`, `validation_action` (blocked|coerced), `validation_policy` (strict|legacy), and `coercion_detail` when applied. Sample full payloads at 1% with PII redaction. Also add a counter `coercion_count{route}` and histogram `reject_rate_by_route`.

tasha: Console UX: can we add a per-route card showing top validation_reasons, an example raw payload and the coerced payload side-by-side, and a quick link to revert the last validator change? Support asked for this.

omar: I'll implement the adapter quick-coerce for null and deploy to beta-union-test only. Will include a trace flag `coercion=coerce_null` and log both original and coerced payloads to S3 with sampling.

greta: I'll roll back the validator tightening from main to a rollback branch, but let's not merge until we confirm adapter mitigates noise. Also add a canary check in the validator CI that runs a suite including explicit nulls in union arms.

hugo: For quotas/billing00: We should not count validation rejects as billable errors. Some ops dashboards generate billing incidents from a derived streams. I'll add a mapping change: validation rejects -> do not trigger billing pages; mark them `validation_class=nonbillable`. We'll mute billing alerts for 30m while this is in flight.

telemetry-bot: metric update requested: add tag validation_reason, validation_action, validation_policy. Set sample rate for full payloads to 1%. Create alert if reject_rate_by_route > 0.3% sustained for 10m.

tasha: PRs: adapter coerce null -> github.com/redwood/adapter/pull/1203 (will push tests), telemetry PR -> github.com/redwood/observability/pull/987, console card -> github.com/redwood/console/pull/551.

omar: Deploy-bot: starting canary deploy: adapter-coerce-null v1 -> beta-union-test (initiated by omar) :truck:

deploy-bot: deploy finished: adapter-coerce-null v1 -> beta-union-test :white_check_mark:

greta: Seeing immediate reduction in pages. Will keep shim TTL to 2 hours and monitor coercion_count. If coercion_count > 1% of traffic for 30m, we rollback the model tag.

hugo: Console filter added for validation_action and coercion_detail. Added small note: "coercion=true indicates runtime recovery; check raw payloads in logs". Also added sample diff view for expected vs actual.

tasha: Thanks. Action items recap: 1) omar deploy adapter shim (done), 2) hugo add telemetry tags + alert (in progress), 3) greta prepare validator CI preflight + rollback branch, 4) console card PR for support. I'll follow up with a short incident note if rollback occurs.
